thread:
Nina: Quickshare: onboarding tutorial broken on Safari when backgrounded during streaming. Repro in quickstart.
Arjun: steps?
Nina: open quickstart in Safari Tech Preview, start a streaming chat, background the app for ~7s, then foreground. Sometimes we get \"Unexpected token < in JSON at position 0\" and the UI shows garbage.
Priya: Safari? That's new. Node and Chrome were flaky but not this.
Nina: grabbed the raw chunks from the inspector, here's a simplified capture:
```data: {\"id\":\"x1\",\"chunk\":\"{\\\"role\\\":\\\"assistant\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"hey\\\"}\\n\"}

:data:keptalive

data: {\"id\":\"x1\",\"chunk\":\"{\\\"role\\\":\\\"assistant\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"you there\\\"}\"}
```
After resuming Safari sometimes merges the trailing colon comment into the next data line so the client sees `:data:keptalive\ndata:` in the same buffer and our SSE line-splitter treats it as a malformed tag.
Arjun: interesting — WebKit's stream boundaries are less stable after suspend. We assumed each `data:` line is atomic.
Priya: short-term for the tutorial: change keepalive to a single colon comment (`:hb\n`) and add explicit `\n` between logical chunks on the server. Also update quickstart README to warn about Safari backgrounding during demo.
Nina: added a note in onboarding docs.
Arjun: SDK fix idea: make the browser SSE parser tolerant of colon-prefixed fragments even if they're mid-buffer. Implementation: always treat any line that starts with `:` anywhere after a previous CRLF as a comment; if `:` appears mid-buffer without preceding CRLF, try to re-scan back to the last CRLF boundary and treat content accordingly.
Priya: also add a small reassembly window (50ms) before emitting parse error; on parsing failure attempt to merge with previous buffer and retry once. Feature-flag it so we can roll back.
build-bot: Created issue devex/sdk-js#2045: \"safari streaming: background resume merges comment+data fragments -> parse error\"
Arjun: add an e2e that runs WebKit + throttled CPU/network and backgrounds tab to catch this. Might be flaky but useful in CI optional matrix.
Priya: will add a unit test that simulates mid-buffer `:comment` + `data:` merge and assert parser normalizes it. Also adding debug logs to the quickstart so we can paste raw binary boundaries when filing bugs.
Nina: thanks, this will stop new hires hitting the weird Safari crash during demos.
Arjun: ping when PR's ready and we'll validate quickstart gallery.
